evals.name: loki-on-flux-with-eso
evals.prompt: I want to add Loki for log aggregation to our cluster. The GitOps repo for our infrastructure is at <FIXTURE_PATH>. Please configure persistence with a 50Gi PVC.
evals.expected_output: FluxCD manifests (HelmRepository + HelmRelease + Kustomization + namespace) for Loki, written under infra/loki/ to match the existing Pattern D layout. No ExternalSecret needed (Loki with filesystem storage). Persistence configured at 50Gi.

assertions.name: picked_flux
assertions.text: Generated manifests use FluxCD (kind: HelmRelease), not ArgoCD

assertions.name: pattern_d_layout
assertions.text: Files written under infra/loki/ to match Pattern D component-based layout

assertions.name: kustomization_present
assertions.text: kustomization.yaml present in the new loki directory

assertions.name: helmrepository_present
assertions.text: HelmRepository resource generated

assertions.name: chart_version_pinned
assertions.text: HelmRelease chart.spec.version is a specific pinned version

assertions.name: chart_version_current
assertions.text: Chart version is current (Loki forked to grafana-community in Mar 2026; current is 14.x community / 7.x grafana)

assertions.name: persistence_50gi
assertions.text: Loki persistence configured at 50Gi as the user explicitly requested

assertions.name: no_unneeded_externalsecret
assertions.text: No unnecessary ExternalSecret generated (filesystem-mode Loki needs none)

assertions.name: namespace_present
assertions.text: namespace.yaml generated for the new loki namespace

evals.name: cert-manager-argocd-cloudflare-dns01
evals.prompt: Set up cert-manager in our cluster with Cloudflare DNS01 challenges for ACME so we can get wildcard certificates. Our GitOps repo is at <FIXTURE_PATH>. We use Cloudflare as our DNS provider.
evals.expected_output: ArgoCD Application for cert-manager under argocd/apps/. ClusterIssuer with Cloudflare DNS01 solver referencing a Kubernetes Secret. Cloudflare Secret (if generated) is a placeholder template with a warning, not a real token.

assertions.name: picked_argocd
assertions.text: Generated manifests use ArgoCD (kind: Application), not Flux

assertions.name: argocd_apps_path
assertions.text: cert-manager Application placed under argocd/apps/ to match existing convention

assertions.name: chart_version_pinned
assertions.text: Application's targetRevision is a specific pinned chart version

assertions.name: chart_version_current
assertions.text: cert-manager chart version is current (within ~2 minors of v1.20.2 as of May 2026)

assertions.name: cloudflare_dns01_clusterissuer
assertions.text: ClusterIssuer/Issuer generated with Cloudflare DNS01 solver

assertions.name: cloudflare_token_via_secret
assertions.text: Cloudflare API token referenced via Secret (apiTokenSecretRef), not plaintext

assertions.name: cloudflare_secret_is_placeholder
assertions.text: Cloudflare API token Secret (if generated) contains a placeholder + warning, not a real-looking token

assertions.name: crd_install_handled
assertions.text: CRDs handled (installCRDs:true or ServerSideApply=true)

evals.name: greenfield-prometheus-grafana
evals.prompt: I need to set up Prometheus and Grafana to monitor my cluster. We're just getting started with GitOps. Repo path: <FIXTURE_PATH>.
evals.expected_output: Combined kube-prometheus-stack chart (not two separate charts) in a component directory under infra/ or infrastructure/. Pinned version. Manifests use one tool's CRDs (no mixing).

assertions.name: uses_kube_prometheus_stack
assertions.text: Output uses combined kube-prometheus-stack chart, NOT two separate Prometheus and Grafana charts

assertions.name: pattern_d_recommended
assertions.text: Output structure groups manifests in a component directory under infra/ or infrastructure/

assertions.name: chart_version_pinned
assertions.text: Chart version pinned to a specific release

assertions.name: chart_version_current
assertions.text: kube-prometheus-stack chart version is current (within ~5 minors of 85.x as of May 2026)

assertions.name: manifests_match_chosen_tool
assertions.text: Generated manifests use the right CRDs for the chosen tool (no mixing)
